title: Exhaustive JVM 330 Two editors increment the same revision
description: Four of six legal read/write interleavings lose one increment when a write uses its saved value. Certify the complete integer envelope of each frozen claim, run its actual guard and assertion with fresh application classes at each input, compare the direct data to its oracle, and replay any witness on a separate JVM.
expected: Every admitted point is accounted for and each declared disposition agrees with the independently checked byte-bound certificate.
